severity_rationale: C4 Centralization: admin-only operation (setDispatcherHook is onlyOwner) with missing atomic drain logic that could strand accrued mint-debt on the outgoing hook during a governance-initiated migration. Per C4 criteria: 'Governance/Centralization risk including admin privileges' goes to QA/Centralization. The harm only materialises when the owner performs a hook-swap governance action without first externally pulling from the old hook — this is admin-process risk rather than a protocol bug exploitable by an external attacker. No direct theft path; recovery requires off-chain owner action on the old hook. Classified Centralization (C-01) because the issue is a missing ordering discipline in an admin-only setter.
title: setDispatcherHook does not run _syncBudget before swapping the hook, stranding undrawn mint-debt on the outgoing hook
description: setDispatcherHook(newHook) replaces the dispatcherHook storage variable with no prior call to the outgoing hook's pull(). Any accrued mintDebt on the outgoing hook remains unclaimed (and potentially unclaimable by this contract) after the swap, because pull() on the new hook does not realise the old hook's ledger. The comment on _syncBudget emphasises 'Always settle accrual under the OLD rate before mutating anything,' but setDispatcherHook bypasses that discipline for the hook's own accrual.
attack_path: 1) Dispatcher hook A has accumulated 1000 phUSD of mintDebt available to this contract via A.pull(). 2) Owner sets dispatcherHook = B (e.g., migration to a new hook contract). 3) The 1000 phUSD mintDebt on A is stranded unless A.pull() can still be called out-of-band by the old recipient (which is still this contract, but this contract only ever calls `dispatcherHook.pull()`, which now points to B). 4) There is no admin path in NFTStaker to drain A. Owner must go off-chain / through governance on A to recover.
impact: Potential loss of accrued mint-debt during hook migrations. Magnitude depends on accrued debt at migration time. Mitigation requires out-of-band intervention on the old hook.
recommendation: In setDispatcherHook, call _syncBudget() first (which calls the current hook's pull() and then settles accrual) before storing newHook. Alternatively add a one-shot `pullFromOldHook(IBalancerPoolerMintDebtHook old) external onlyOwner` that allows draining a previous hook after migration.

sanitization.rationale: Root cause is setDispatcherHook setter ordering in NFTStaker.sol (lines 134-137): mutating dispatcherHook before syncing. Not a 'reckless admin mistake' — migration is an expected, documented operation; the contract should atomically drain the outgoing hook as part of the swap.
